Name: Customize Anywhere
Author: ChroniclerCherry
TagLine: Lets you customize your character and access a wardrobe with all clothing from anywhere, or via in-game items.
Description:
Lets you customize your character and access a wardrobe with all clothing from anywhere, or via in-game Clothing Catalogue and Customization Mirror items.

**Install**

1.  [Install the latest version of SMAPI](https://smapi.io).

2.  Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].

3.  Run the game using SMAPI.
**How to use**
You can buy the recipes for a Customization Mirror and Clothing Catalogue from Robin's shop for 50,000g each. They can be crafted with 10 wood + 2 refined quartz and 10 wood respectively. You can place them in the world, then interact with them to open the character customization screen and a clothing catalogue (which includes custom clothing added by other mods).

You can also use these key bindings to access the features:

*   [font=Courier New]LeftShift + 1[/font]: open the character customization screen.

*   [font=Courier New]LeftShift + 2[/font]: open the dyes menu (if you saw the event that unlocks dyeing).

*   [font=Courier New]LeftShift + 3[/font]: open the tailoring menu (if you saw the event that unlocks tailoring).

*   [font=Courier New]LeftShift + 4[/font]: open the clothing catalogue.
You can optionally use [Generic Mod Config Menu](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098) to configure...

*   whether the above key binds are enabled;

*   whether you can open the tailoring UI before you unlock tailoring in the base game;

*   and the key binds.
**Common questions**

> **Is the mod still compatible?**
> The mod is compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.

> **Does the mod conflict with any others?**
> There are no known mod conflicts. Feel free to report compatibility issues in the mod comments.

> **Does this add new character options or clothing?**
> No, this just provides a convenient way to customize your character or clothing. There are many mods which add new clothing those, which should work fine alongside this mod.

> **Can I safely add/remove the mod anytime?**
> Yep. Removing the mod won't undo the character customizations or clothing you chose.
